name: WakeDiscWaiter
evidence: original assembly: the alarm handler of WaitDiscTicks, which signals its semaphore

name: WaitDiscTicks
evidence: creates a semaphore, arms an alarm (ScheduleAlarm) of a number of ticks whose handler signals it and waits on it

name: EndDiscCommand
evidence: the end of a command, from the remote call's end callback in the interrupt: records its status and releases the command's semaphore and the callback's

name: CopyDiscReadTail
evidence: the read's end callback: copies the two unaligned pieces the IOP left in uncached memory to where they go

name: CreateDiscSemaphores
evidence: creates the semaphores of the two disc clients' commands and of the callback, once

name: DeleteDiscSemaphores
evidence: signals the callback's semaphore if one is pending, deletes the three semaphores and clears the command 0x80000012's handler

name: RunDiscCallback
evidence: the handler of the command 0x80000012: runs the disc callback with its argument unless it is being installed

name: InstallDiscCallbackHandler
evidence: installs RunDiscCallback as the handler of the command 0x80000012

name: BeginDiscNCommand
evidence: takes the semaphore of the first disc client's commands for a command, and binds the client to the service 0x80000595 once, printing "Ncmd fail sema" when busy

name: GetDiscDriveState
evidence: sends the first disc client command 0xE and returns the word it gets back; ReadDiscSectors refuses to start a read when it is 6

name: SyncDiscNCommand
evidence: waits for the first disc client's command to end (mode 0) or tells whether it is still running (mode 1), printing "N cmd wait" (SyncDiscRead forwards to it)

name: SyncDiscSCommand
evidence: the same for the second disc client's commands, printing "S cmd wait"

name: BeginDiscSCommand
evidence: takes the semaphore of the second disc client's commands, and binds the client to the service 0x80000593 once, printing "Scmd fail sema" when busy

name: InitDiscLibrary
evidence: original assembly: binds the disc library to the IOP and initialises it, printing its "CD_Init" message on a bind error (LoadIopModules calls it)

name: WaitDiscReady
evidence: original assembly: waits until the drive reports ready, with its "DiskReady" messages (LoadIopModules and EnsureSoundBankLoaded call it)

name: SendDiscSValueCommand
evidence: sends the second disc client command 0x22 with one word and returns the word the reply holds

name: GetDiscReadPosition
evidence: returns the word the IOP keeps in D_0027A5C0, read through its uncached address (RefillBufferedStreamFromSectors calls it)

name: ReadDiscSectors
evidence: original assembly: starts a read of a count of sectors into a buffer with the first client ("call cdread cmd"); StartDiscRead forwards to it

name: GetDiscStatus
evidence: the second client's command 3, returning its word (func_00140968 polls it)

name: GetDiscError
evidence: the second client's command 4, returning the drive's error word (GetDiscReadError forwards to it)

name: StopDiscRead
evidence: the second client's command 0x16 (CloseBufferedStream calls it to finish a pending sector read)

name: CheckDiscChanged
evidence: the second client's command 5 with one word, returning a word through out (StepDiscSectorCheck calls it with 2 and shows its page when the word is set)
